mp: Lifestyle piece E — permission & small-joy slips open in-board into a fuller slip
publishedCommit: live bundle index-DeT38xfF.js (was index-DbD-I9MD.js at first walk)
priorDefect: FIXED — first walk (bundle index-DbD-I9MD.js) found 'ReferenceError: Star is not defined' (LifestyleEliteShell.jsx:1214, PermissionSlipLens) crashing the whole Lifestyle page via the top-level ErrorBoundary. Star has since been added to the lucide import and redeployed; the crash is gone.

assertions.name: 1-bottom-shelf-intact
assertions.expected: 'Permission & small joys' label + a row of cover cards
assertions.got: label visible; cover titles: A slow Sunday just for you, A long walk somewhere new, Cook something that takes all afternoon, Visit a gallery alone, A film and an early night, Ten minutes outside no phone (+ permission slips)

assertions.name: 2-cited-slip-opens-in-board
assertions.expected: role=dialog FaceOverlay covers board face; big serif title ~24-26px; 'Why this is good for you' block; italic citation source line; doable button; URL unchanged (no /LifestyleDetail)
assertions.got: dialog=true; title='You're allowed a slow Sunday.' @25px Cormorant Garamond; header='Why this is good for you'; source='Sonnentag & Fritz, J. Organizational Behavior (2015)' (italic); doable=['Book a quiet hour']; url stayed /Lifestyle
assertions.note: In-board overlay, not a route. Screenshot cited_slip.png.

assertions.name: 3-honesty-split-kindness-not-claim
assertions.expected: gentler-pace slip header reads EXACTLY 'A kindness, not a claim' (NOT 'Why this is good for you') AND no citation/source line
assertions.got: dialog=true; title='A gentler pace today isn't falling behind.'; headerExact='A kindness, not a claim'; hasWhyGood=false; sourceLinePresent=false (no et al, no year). Body: 'There's no study that says slow down for your cycle — but real, documented symptoms can make a gentler pace the sensible, kind choice. This is permission, not a prescription.'
assertions.note: ANTI-FAKE-SCIENCE GATE PASSES — honest kindness, no laundered citation. Verified live (pixels) + screenshot kindness_slip.png.

assertions.name: 4-doable-ticks-no-nav
assertions.expected: tap doable -> checked 'In your planner' + bloom; URL unchanged; board not scrolled away
assertions.got: inPlanner=true; dialog svg count=4 (Pollinator bloom rendered); url stayed /Lifestyle; scrollDelta=0

assertions.name: 5-back-returns
assertions.expected: tap Back (aria-label 'Back') -> dialog gone, good-life board visible
assertions.got: dialogPresent=false; boardVisible=true (Permission & small joys back on screen)

assertions.name: 6-regression-piece-d-time-for
assertions.expected: tap top-shelf 'Time for?' -> FaceOverlay opens with time bands
assertions.got: dialog=true; 'What have you got time for? / A read · a listen · a little joy / Pick by the time you have — a small, chosen handful, never an endless...' ; url stayed /Lifestyle
assertions.note: Piece D intact. Overlay opens after ~1-2s smooth-scroll; polled. Screenshot time_overlay_open.png.

assertions.name: 8-console-error-classification
assertions.expected: no NEW ReferenceError/TDZ/app-code error beyond baseline
assertions.got: NEW errors: NONE. The Star ReferenceError is gone. Baseline only (ignored per brief): 'N.entities.User.me is not a function', 'App not found', apps/null 404s, connect_error/socket 'Connection rejected by server'.

notes: Re-verify after the Star import fix: piece E now works end-to-end on live (bundle index-DeT38xfF.js). Tapping a 'Permission & small joys' cover opens the in-board FaceOverlay with the slip big (25px Cormorant Garamond), the correct why-block, and one doable that writes to the planner and ticks + blooms with no navigation. The honesty split is honoured: cited slips ('You're allowed a slow Sunday.') show 'Why this is good for you' + a real italic citation (Sonnentag & Fritz, 2015); the cycle slip ('A gentler pace today isn't falling behind.') shows 'A kindness, not a claim' with NO source line — the anti-fake-science gate passes. Back returns to the board; piece D 'Time for?' still opens; no horizontal overflow; no NEW console errors (User.me baseline only). All 8 assertions pass. Exit gate: PASS.
